urls.title: Resume URLs
urls.description: One or more direct download URLs to PDF or DOCX resume files.

llm_model.title: LLM Model
llm_model.description: Model for section extraction. With OPENROUTER_API_KEY, bare names get an "openai/" prefix. Cheaper models work well for most resumes.

max_concurrency.title: Max Concurrent Requests
max_concurrency.description: Maximum number of resumes to process in parallel. Keep at 5 to avoid OpenAI rate limits.

llm_api_key.title: Your LLM API key (optional)
llm_api_key.description: Use your own OpenRouter (sk-or-...) or OpenAI key. Leave empty to use the actor's built-in key, if the owner has set one.
